findings.current: “I’m glad I’m not late. Chunsoo, you’re here too.”
findings.defect: The draft resolves the deliberately incomplete “자네도” by adding that Chunsoo is present.
findings.rationale: The source leaves Kim Hwajong’s second thought elliptical and does not say “you’re here.”
findings.replacement: “I’m glad I’m not too late. You too, Chunsoo.”

findings.current: The mountain shook with the name he had shouted for the first time in thirty years.
findings.defect: The draft reduces 관등성명, a formal military identification consisting of rank or position and name, to merely “the name,” weakening the military-conditioning joke and its later callback.
findings.rationale: Im Chunsoo shouts both “Trainee Number One” and his name, and the source explicitly calls the formula 관등성명.
findings.replacement: The mountain shook as he bellowed out his military identification for the first time in thirty years.

findings.current: For some people, the walk back down the mountain was a hellish experience.
findings.defect: The plural “some people” changes the source’s singular 누군가, which points to one particular person.
findings.rationale: 누군가에게는 is singular and sets up the Security Team Leader’s interrogation.
findings.replacement: For one person, the walk back down the mountain was a hellish experience.
findings.source: 그 후 산에서 내려오는 길은 누군가에게는 지옥 같은 시간이었다.

findings.current: Let me tell you in advance: don’t bother making any pointless requests on my behalf.
findings.defect: “On my behalf” reverses the direction of the request, making it sound as though the Security Team Leader might petition someone else for Team Leader 1’s benefit.
findings.rationale: Team Leader 1 is warning the Security Team Leader not to solicit his intervention or support.
findings.replacement: Let me tell you up front: don’t ask me for any favors.
findings.source: 미리 말해 두는데, 괜한 청탁 같은 건 하지 않길 바랍니다.

findings.current: “Team Leader, I’m sorry to bring this up in this kind of atmosphere, but I think I just heard the Guild Master’s voice.”
findings.defect: Dropping the numeral makes the address ambiguous because both Team Leader 1 and the Security Team Leader are present in the exchange.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly addresses 1팀장님, distinguishing him from the speaking Security Team Leader.
findings.replacement: “Team Leader 1, I’m sorry to bring this up in this kind of atmosphere, but I think I just heard the Guild Master’s voice.”
findings.source: “저기, 1팀장님. 이런 분위기에서 죄송합니다만, 방금 길드장님 목소리를 들은 것 같은데요.”

findings.current: “Who did you just say that was? What do you mean, giving their name and rank?”
findings.defect: The draft has Team Leader 1 ask for the distant shouter’s identity, but the source asks which person in the group just made the comment about military identification.
findings.rationale: 방금 말한 사람 refers to the subordinate who has just spoken, not to the person whose shout they heard.
findings.replacement: “Who just said that? What was that about giving a name and rank?”

findings.current: Do you want to dance with swords today?
findings.defect: The draft turns Im Chunsoo’s threat to unleash violence on them into an invitation for the Security Team to participate in a sword fight.
findings.rationale: 칼춤 한번 춰 is a threatening idiom in which Im Chunsoo is the implied agent of the violence.
findings.replacement: Do I need to make my sword dance today?

findings.defect: The draft formats Jin Taekyung’s internal reaction as spoken dialogue.
findings.rationale: The source has no quotation marks and presents this as narration-internal thought, consistent with the surrounding first-person passage.

findings.current: He had made a former war hero do a hundred sets of PT Exercise No. 8, then later kicked him in the ribs with his hard-soled shoe.
findings.defect: The draft changes the location of the kick from the shin to the ribs and adds the unsupported detail that the shoe had a hard sole.
findings.rationale: 쪼인트를 까다 specifically describes kicking someone in the shin, while 구둣발 indicates a dress-shoe-clad foot rather than emphasizing the sole.
findings.replacement: He had made a former war hero do a hundred sets of PT Exercise No. 8, then later kicked him in the shin with his dress shoe.
findings.source: 옛 전쟁 영웅한테 PT 8번 100세트를 시키더니, 나중에는 구둣발로 쪼인트를 깠다.

findings.defect: “Smack” invents a rapid series of blows during the attention–at-ease drill, although the source onomatopoeia conveys Im Chunsoo’s rapid movements.
findings.rationale: The sound immediately follows alternating posture commands; the source does not state that Butler Kim strikes him at this point.

findings.current: If someone was Class 3 at the Hunter Training Center, they could gather every Guild Master in the country on a parade ground and beat them into line.
findings.defect: The idiomatic “beat them into line” obscures the source’s literal comic image of lining up the Guild Masters and beating them with a bat.
findings.rationale: 줄 빠따를 치다 refers to administering a group punishment by lining people up and beating them, not figuratively bringing them into compliance.
findings.replacement: If someone was Class 3 at the Hunter Training Center, they could line up every Guild Master in the country on a parade ground and beat every last one of them with a bat.
findings.source: 헌터 훈련소 3기면 전국 길드장들을 연병장에 모아 놓고 줄 빠따를 쳐도 된다.

findings.current: But Butler Kim had taught Im Chunsoo and helped him rise to his current position, too.
findings.defect: “Helped him rise” weakens Butler Kim’s formative agency and the hierarchy being inferred from his former role as Im Chunsoo’s instructor.
findings.rationale: The source attributes Im Chunsoo’s instruction and rise to his present position directly to Butler Kim, while retaining Jin Taekyung’s inferential 볼 수 있다.
findings.replacement: You could say Butler Kim was the one who taught Im Chunsoo and raised him to his current position.
findings.source: 임춘수를 가르쳐서 지금의 위치까지 오르게 한 것도 김 집사라고 볼 수 있다.

summary: Several actionable fidelity issues alter subjects, implied actions, military register, quantities, and physical details; the most serious make an internal thought spoken dialogue, reverse the direction of a favor request, misidentify who is being questioned, and change a kick from the shin to the ribs.
